paragraphs: The Defender D200 is part of the modern L663 generation, introduced in 2019. It uses the Ingenium AJ200D, a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel engine, which in the D200 is paired with a mild-hybrid (MHEV) system. This engine family is used across the wider JLR range and has known patterns around timing chain wear and, for MHEV variants like the D200, DC-DC converter failure. Knowing these specifics matters, because the components, the known wear pattern, and the rebuild specifics differ from the non-MHEV petrol models.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ200D engines for every Defender D200 on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre 4-cylinder diesel fitted to the Defender D200 from 2019. This is an Ingenium diesel with a mild-hybrid system. Known for the Ingenium timing chain pattern and DC-DC converter failure pattern — see the callout above. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, and service the DC-DC converter as standard where applicable.

compatibility.intro: Because the D200 uses the AJ200D which is shared with the D240, and the petrol P300 shares the same base engine without the MHEV system, correct identification is critical. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm: - Your exact engine code (AJ200D) - Your generation (L663) - Drivetrain and ancillary specification, particularly the MHEV components - Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build
